title.narrative: Activités de communication de l'Initiative de recherche concertée sur l'adaptation en Afrique et en Asie
Collaborative Adaptation Research Initiative in Africa and Asia Communications Activities

description.narrative: The Collaborative Adaptation Research Initiative in Africa and Asia (CARIAA) is designed to develop robust evidence to inform how to increase the resilience of vulnerable populations in climate change hot spots in Africa and Asia. It is important for CARIAA to put in place strategies to communicate about its activities and results. This Research Support Project (RSP) is to fund communications activities related with the start-up of the program, including the development of a communications strategy, an approach for branding, and translation, so that the program provides a fully bilingual interface.
